title: Longest Unbeaten Runs in International Football: Spain 43 🤯 #shorts
description:
The longest unbeaten runs in men's international football: Spain are unbeaten in 43 games (as of 13 Nov 2026) after beating Czechia 2–0 in the Nations League, ahead of Italy's 37 (2018–2021), Argentina's 36 (2019–2022), Brazil's 35 (1993–1996) and Spain's own 35 (2007–2009). Spain's run started in March 2024, and they ended Italy's 37-game record run with a 2–1 win in Milan in October 2021. England can end it in Madrid on Sunday.

title: Italy vs France 3–1: First Home Win Over France Since 1962 🇮🇹 #shorts
description:
Italy beat France 3–1 at San Siro in the UEFA Nations League, their first home win over France since 1962 and Zinedine Zidane's first defeat as France coach. Michael Olise put France ahead, Pio Esposito equalised, Davide Frattesi made it 2–1 and Esposito scored a penalty after his brother Sebastiano had missed one. France played without Kylian Mbappé.

title: Cade Cunningham 52 Points, 0 Turnovers | Pistons vs Wizards 2OT 🔥 #shorts
description:
Cade Cunningham scored a career-high 52 points with 11 assists and no turnovers as the Detroit Pistons beat the Washington Wizards 144–140 in double overtime. He is the first NBA player with 50 points, 10 assists and zero turnovers since turnovers were first tracked in 1977–78 (OptaSTATS). Ausar Thompson had his first career triple-double (17 points, 11 rebounds, 11 assists); Trae Young scored 37 for Washington and Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr had 30 each.
